description: This file defines a PHP class ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber that subscribes to HTTP request events within the Symfony framework. Its purpose is to detect if a request targets a disabled module and throw appropriate exceptions to prevent access or redirect. It contains methods for event handling and service retrieval, making it integral to module access control logic.

classes.name: ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to kernel request events to block access to disabled modules by throwing exceptions or forwarding requests.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ModuleService used to check for disabled modules.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Defines the events this subscriber listens to; specifically, kernel request events with priority 200.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Event handler that checks if the request targets a disabled module and throws an exception or forwards accordingly.
